criteria: Faithful traditional sacred painting and figural accomplishment, not simply museum fame
Devotional intensity: strong theological visual presentation and human expression
Harmonious colour and painterly maturity, substantive composition
No weak art to fill biblical or calendar slots: no art is a legitimate outcome
Exact historical source identification and commercial rights are subsequent technical gates, never beauty compensation
methodNote: Visual comparison made against verified institutional artwork identities and historical reference images; benchmark photos served remotely in chat's HTML and are not independently master SHA-acquired. Seven original research candidates were locally SHA-verified and visually assessed from existing acquisitions. A/B are assistant artistic curation hypotheses, not user selection.

records.title: The Annunciation
records.observedArtisticMerits: Illuminated Gabriel and Marian response; commanding blue and red drapery, coherent structure, accomplished figure painting and sacred restraint. High level comparable with established Champaigne painterly direction.
records.artisticLimitation: This is an historical chosen/researched source; do not change user-selected current original or presume final A approval.

records.title: Saint Lucy
records.observedArtisticMerits: Zurbarán's extremely accomplished form, textures, chromatic quality and solemn half-length saint figure give painterly density close to the Rubens apostle portrait benchmark.
records.artisticLimitation: Saint's attire and attributes do not assert photographic authenticity. Human curator must decide whether this A contender fits Saint Lucy.

records.title: Christ and the Woman of Samaria
records.observedArtisticMerits: Intimate naturalistic Christ-woman exchange, polished balanced oil, believable human faces and warm chromatic unity. Strong Gospel passage image.
records.artisticLimitation: More restrained literary intimacy than the very powerful Ribalta benchmark; insufficient reason to designate exceptional Home masterpiece.

records.title: The Miraculous Draught of Fishes
records.observedArtisticMerits: Well-painted dynamic multi-person drama and rich Venetian colour, fully achieved long narrative composition, not a decorative illustration.
records.artisticLimitation: Extreme landscape width, Christ at left; should retain full composition. Not Luke 21 or John 21.

records.title: Rest on the Flight into Egypt
records.observedArtisticMerits: Gracefully rendered Holy Family and angel in coherent circular composition, humane devotional sensitivity, soft painterly atmosphere.
records.artisticLimitation: Distinct Rest stage, not the actual Flight; preserve circular original, no artificial 9:16 cover crop.

records.title: The Flight into Egypt
records.observedArtisticMerits: Attractive substantial naturalistic figures and bright chromatic arrangement; source authentic.
records.artisticLimitation: Ornamental cherub group and lively Baroque decorative quality may lack the emotional and spiritual gravitas of Ribalta, Navarrete or La Tour; no A recommendation.

records.title: The Baptism of Christ
records.observedArtisticMerits: Sombre classicist Christ/John tableau, attractive figure modelling and legible baptism, artistically legitimate painting.
records.artisticLimitation: Oval pictorial arrangement and relatively diffuse finish are less powerful than the reference benchmark set; no A recommendation.
